result.title: SyncPro: Synchronous Reasoning and Responding for Proactive Streaming Video Understanding
result.summary: Proactive streaming video understanding requires assistants to track unfolding events and respond when a user's requested condition is met. To make these decisions, assistants must accumulate relevant evidence and reassess response conditions as new observations arrive. Existing work offers complementary capabilities for this process: proactive video assistants learn when to respond, while streaming video reasoning methods generate scheduled intermediate text to organize observations and support subsequent answers. Together, these capabilities provide a foundation for proactive reasoning, but how to coordinate ongoing reasoning with timely responses remains underexplored. In a direct adaptation, fixed reasoning intervals can trigger updates when nothing relevant has changed or postpone useful updates until the next scheduled step. Sharing one generation path also couples two distinct requirements: preserving evidence for future decisions and producing only the response requested by the user. Moreover, responses generated after reasoning must wait for it to finish, even when sufficient evidence is already available. To address these challenges, we introduce SyncPro, a synchronous dual-stream framework with specialized generation paths for evidence tracking and user-facing responses. Its Inner and Response branches share causal history and activate independently, allowing relevant evidence changes to trigger internal updates and responses to proceed concurrently with ongoing reasoning. We construct 189K dual-stream examples and train SyncPro through supervised fine-tuning followed by trajectory-level reinforcement learning. Experiments across three proactive benchmarks show improved response timing and more accurate answers to user requests.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SyncPro，一个面向主动式流式视频理解的双流框架：Inner 分支持续跟踪证据，Response 分支独立生成用户所需回答，两者共享因果历史并各自激活；作者构建了 189K 双流样本，采用 SFT 加轨迹级强化学习训练，在三个主动式基准上改善了响应时机与回答准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应「何时响应」的停止决策、证据累积与动态计算成本问题；其证据流与回答流分离的生成路径可供核查是否能缓解证据保留与输出目标相耦合，但中间推理仍为文本而非 latent 状态。
